suggested_solution: Disable or lower CPU boost settings in Armoury Crate or G-Helper.
Restrict CPU power under “Fans + Power” with a 35-40W limit and apply the changes.
Check PCH (Platform Controller Hub) temperatures using HWINFO to ensure they are within safe limits.
Consider repasting thermal paste or replacing it if necessary.
Ensure proper airflow around the laptop, especially when running demanding games.
